Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting prepaid legal service plans from insurance regulation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prepaid legal service plans; and adding a newsection to chapter 48.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The business of prepaid legal service plans is not insuranceunder RCW 48.01.040 and is not subject to regulation under this title. (2) For purposes of this section, "prepaid legal service plan"means an arrangement that provides specified legal services orreimbursement for legal expenses in consideration of a specifiedpayment for an interval of time. It does not include a policy ofinsurance, or coverage incidental to that insurance, issued by aninsurer having a valid certificate of authority in this state if thepolicy is issued under the general laws in this title pertaining toinsurance.
